questions.modelAnswer: Dung confusion matrix: precision = TP/(TP+FP), recall = TP/(TP+FN), F1 = 2PR/(P+R). Code: cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred); TP=cm[1,1]; FP=cm[0,1]; FN=cm[1,0]; tinh P, R, F1; can than chia cho 0 (tra ve 0.0). Giai thich: accuracy gay hieu lam khi lech lop nen bao cao them P/R/F1.
questions.prompt: Viet ham NumPy/sklearn tinh precision, recall, F1 tu hai mang y_true, y_pred (nhi phan 0/1). Giai thich tai sao khong chi bao cao accuracy khi du lieu lech lop.

questions.modelAnswer: 1) Phan tich du lieu: video/cat frame, anh sang nen phuc tap, mat can bang giua cac ky hieu, can augmentation (crop/xoay/sang) + chuan hoa. 2) Mo hinh: baseline CRNN (CNN + RNN) hoac frame-wise classifier + smoothing theo thoi gian; cai tien: backbone ConvNeXt/ResNet + Transformer encoder + attention pooling. 3) Pipeline: trich frame -> backbone -> sequence model -> CTC loss/attention pooling -> giai ma chuoi; validation theo nguoi (person-independent). 4) Metric: accuracy chuoi + CER/WER; bao cao confusion giua cac ky hieu giong nhau. 5) Cai tien: pretrain, pseudo-label video chua gan nhan, ensemble, distillation sang model nhe chay real-time.
questions.prompt: Nhan dien ngon ngu ky hieu tu video (giong de OLP AI 2025): 10.000 clip ngan, 50 ky hieu, quay boi 100 nguoi khac nhau, anh sang/nen da dang, can chay gan real-time tren laptop thuong. De xuat giai phap theo khung 5 buoc: (1) phan tich du lieu, (2) lua chon mo hinh va ly do, (3) pipeline xu ly, (4) metric danh gia, (5) phuong an cai tien. Khong can code chi tiet.
rubric: Phan tich dung dac thu video: phu thuoc thoi gian, da dang nguoi/nen, yeu cau toc do
Chon mo hinh sequence (CRNN/Transformer) co ly do, baseline truoc cai tien sau
Pipeline day du trich frame -> backbone -> sequence -> decode, tranh data leakage theo nguoi
Metric dung (accuracy chuoi/CER-WER) thay vi accuracy frame don
De xuat it nhat 2 cai tien kha thi (pretrain/augment/pseudo-label/ensemble/distill)

questions.modelAnswer: 1) Phan tich: cap cau song ngu Hoa-Viet, do dai lech, tu chuyen nganh; tien xu ly: tach tu tieng Trung/Viet, chuan hoa, BPE chung/gan; chia validation theo mien. 2) Mo hinh: baseline Seq2Seq + attention; chinh: Transformer (multi-head + positional) hoac fine-tune model MT pretrain. 3) Pipeline: tien xu ly -> BPE -> train voi label smoothing -> beam search decode. 4) Metric: SacreBLEU (chuan hoa tokenize) + danh gia nguoi cho cau kho; theo doi ca do dai dich. 5) Cai tien: back-translation, pretrain da ngu, ensemble, rerank, xu ly so/danh tu rieng.

questions.modelAnswer: 1) Phan tich: anh la khoai tay chup ngoai dong, nen phuc tap, benh lech lop (la benh nang hiem), can xac dinh vung benh chu khong chi nhan anh. 2) Mo hinh: baseline classifier (EfficientNet) truoc; chinh: detector 1-stage (YOLO) neu can real-time tren thiet bi dong hoac 2-stage neu can chinh xac vung benh nho; dung pretrain. 3) Pipeline: augment (crop/flip/mau) -> detector voi NMS + IoU>=0.5 -> loc theo nguong tin cay; chia fold theo ruong/ngay chup. 4) Metric: mAP@0.5 (+mAP@[.5:.95]) thay vi accuracy; bao cao precision/recall tung lop benh hiem. 5) Cai tien: class weights/focal loss cho lop hiem, pseudo-label, test-time augmentation, distill sang model nhe.

Pipeline co augment + NMS + chia fold dung (theo ruong, tranh leakage)
Metric dung mAP + precision/recall lop hiem thay vi accuracy
Xu ly mat can bang (focal/class weights) + it nhat 1 cai tien toc do

questions.modelAnswer: 1) Phan tich: du lieu bang 50.000 sinh vien x 40 dac trung (diem, chuyen can, hoc phi...), nhan bo hoc ~8% (lech), thieu du lieu rac; can giai thich duoc cho phong dao tao. 2) Mo hinh: baseline logistic regression; chinh: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM) hoac Random Forest; tranh deep learning vi bang nho + can giai thich. 3) Pipeline: xu ly missing/outlier -> encoding -> chuan hoa neu can -> SMOTE hoac class weights (uu tien class weights de tranh leakage khi CV) -> stratified k-fold -> hieu chuan nguong theo F1. 4) Metric: PR-AUC/F1 thay vi accuracy; bao cao precision/recall o nguong van hanh. 5) Cai tien: feature moi (xu huong diem), SHAP giai thich, giam sat drift theo hoc ky, thu nghiem A/B canh bao som.
